_comment: Second shrink pass (2026-11-01, user: shrink the buildings; brief: keep each building's cost unchanged). tools/material_costs.mjs prices a building from the material families of its exported model (tools/building_material_mix.json). A building shrunk in that pass keeps the families its pre-shrink model showed here, so its family shares and its cost stay as they were. Each entry: the families of the old building_material_mix.json row (git) and the model they were measured on. One key per building; agents add or edit only their own keys.
